I also tightened the layer boundaries by removing rendering behavior from [SearchApplication.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/048_naive_pattern_searching/SearchApplication.java:1) and [SearchResult.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/048_naive_pattern_searching/SearchResult.java:1), leaving formatting in [SearchResultFormatter.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/048_naive_pattern_searching/SearchResultFormatter.java:1) and keeping [NaivePatternSearch.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/048_naive_pattern_searching/NaivePatternSearch.java:1) as a compatibility facade. [NaivePatternSearchTest.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/048_naive_pattern_searching/NaivePatternSearchTest.java:1) now verifies the new CLI support path directly.
